heading: Karnataka HC on EPS-95: What the Pension Ruling Means for You
tldr: The Karnataka High Court has upheld the existing amendments to the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995 (EPS-95).
This ruling rejects the plea from a group of retirees seeking higher pension payouts based on their full salary contributions.
The decision clarifies that the pensionable salary cap of ₹15,000, introduced through amendments, remains valid.
It also confirms the provisions regarding reductions in pension for early retirement.
This outcome has significant implications for many EPFO members' expectations regarding their pension entitlements.
caption:
A recent court decision about your pension could change what you expected for your retirement. The Karnataka High Court has confirmed rules about how much of your salary counts towards your pension. This means the ₹15,000 salary limit for calculating pensions is still in place. It also affects those thinking about early retirement. Read the full article to understand what this means for your future pension.
